HOW: wrap both values with stripInlineMarkup before building text (the intended thread link is built from m.threadUrl, so stripping user markup does not lose the real link).
verificationEvidence.rationale: Confirmed. src/notifications/mentions.ts:22 interpolates m.authorName and m.body directly into the chat text with no stripInlineMarkup call, while the sibling mentionEmail (lines 15-16) and the sanitize.ts contract (lines 1-3: 'Every outbound sink passes user text through stripInlineMarkup first') do sanitize. clients.ts:6 explicitly documents that chat `text` renders chat markup: `<url|label>` becomes a link and `<!channel>` pings everyone. So attacker-controlled comment text (author name/body) becomes a live phishing link or a channel-wide ping sent from our app. No downstream ChatClient implementation strips markup (grep shows the only sanitize usage is in mentionEmail). The fix (wrapping both values with stripInlineMarkup) is valid since the intended thread link is built from m.threadUrl. Finding stands.
